_about: Algernon Charles Swinburne. Bloom's Western Canon (1994) lists: Poems and Letters. Bloom addition 2026-11-03 under Adam's Bloom-only ruling; each row is US public domain (title page, Gutenberg header or IA metadata read, recorded in _bloom).

swinburne-poems-ballads: Poems & Ballads (First Series) -- The Collected Poetical Works, vol. I

swinburne-letters: The Letters of Algernon Charles Swinburne, vol. 1

swinburne-poems-ballads.evidence: Read PG front matter. PG holds the other Collected Poetical Works volumes as separate files (27401 Poems & Ballads II; 18726 III; 4072 Songs before Sunrise; 15378 Atalanta, etc.).
swinburne-poems-ballads.case: Bloom lists Swinburne's poems and letters; nothing by him is held. The Heinemann Collected Poetical Works is on PG volume by volume; Gosse and Wise's 1918 Letters is the PD edition of the letters.
swinburne-poems-ballads.note: Vol. 2 of the Letters needs finding (IA lettersofalgern01swinuoft / lettersofalgerno01swiniala are other copies). The Gosse-Wise text is incomplete and Wise is a known forger; Lang's 1959-62 Letters are not PD.

swinburne-letters.year: 1918 (IA metadata; London: W. Heinemann; title page not reached)
